verdict.rationale: Netlify docs explicitly describe simplifying domain management and adding custom domains per project version [netlify-docs-20], plus automatic HTTPS is provided for these domains [netlify-docs-9], and community feedback confirms custom domains with SSL work well in practice [netlify-comm-8]. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on walkthrough of the custom domain attachment flow beyond docs/testimonials, and no detail on DNS verification edge cases.
